raw_market.question: Louisiana vs. Louisiana Tech: 1H Moneyline
raw_market.description:
In the first half of the college football game between Louisiana and Louisiana Tech, scheduled for October 10 at 7:30 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Louisiana" if Louisiana outscore Louisiana Tech in the first half.

This market will resolve to "Louisiana Tech" if Louisiana Tech outscore Louisiana in the first half.

If both teams score the same number of points in the first half, this market will resolve 50-50.

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
